entities.title: Stored blob facts
entities.summary: The shape of what BlobAnalyzer produces and the store keeps per blob: Bloom bytes, symbols as an array of arrays, identifier occurrences as an object of line lists.
entities.definition: symbols: JSON array of [name, kind, container, line, endLine, sig] (Sym.ToJson), sig cut to 140 characters. idents: JSON object from identifier to a list of 1-based line numbers, negative for a declaration, at most 200 per name (Sym.IdentsToJson). bloom: the filter bytes, empty for binary blobs. digest: "<lang>, <lines> lines" with up to eight type or heading names and a member count, or "binary".
guarantees: The facts depend only on the bytes and the file extension.
Binary blobs have no symbols, identifiers or filter; text over 2 MiB has a filter but no symbols or identifiers.
entities.compatibility: Any change to what is produced for the same bytes must bump Store.ExtractorVersion: the store deletes blobs written by another version when it opens, and they are analysed again.
